results.title: Prendre son souffle à deux mains
results.original_title: Prendre son souffle à deux mains
results.overview: The extraordinary adventures of an octopus as imagined by three children.

results.title: BackToUs
results.overview: Lola and Mia navigate female friendship, competition, and the influence of patriarchal structures, as the pressure for male validation increasingly comes between them.

results.title: Lullaby from the Motherland
results.overview: On his final day in New Delhi, as a young man prepares to leave his homeland behind, he hears a mysterious sound echoing through the city, unnoticed by everyone else.

results.title: A story in white
results.overview: In a quiet, snow-covered mountain world, we follow two friends  searching together for a feeling they can’t quite name. As they journey through the white landscape, they encounter a mysterious snowman who is passing by unsuspectingly.  The film gently draws you into a space of silence, friendship, and the small miracle of simply being together, far away from everything. Made with cold fingers and warm hearts, it’s a love letter to nature, friendship, and the beauty of the unknown.

results.title: Smoking Heals
results.original_title: التدخين يسبب الصحة و يدمر الوفاة
results.overview: What happens when a cigarette box chooses you not the other way around?

results.title: Niceland
results.overview: An elderly pop star seeking a calmer life away from fame arrives in Niceland, a gloomy tropical town, to perform what may be his last show.

results.title: Process
results.overview: During a conversation at a bar, James pries Lucy about the crying technique she uses as a professional actress. Much like Lucy’s technique, the nature of her relationship with James is mysterious. The reality of their conversation begins to unravel as Lucy eventually agrees to take James through her process.

results.title: My Journey with FASD
results.overview: A slice of life animated documentary following a teenager in Aotearoa living with FASD.

results.title: Eine florentinische Tragödie / Herzog Blaubarts Burg - Wiener Staatsoper
results.original_title: Eine florentinische Tragödie / Herzog Blaubarts Burg - Wiener Staatsoper
results.overview: The two short operas Eine Florentinische Tragödie and Herzog Blaubarts Burg are linked by a central theme: the progressive recognition of the only seemingly familiar counterpart.  In Zemlinsky's Eine Florentinische Tragödie, the murder of Bianca's lover by her jealous husband Simone leads to a dialog between the two spouses that surprisingly signals a new beginning of love. In Bartók's one-act opera, however, Judith's journey to the inner depths of her beloved Duke Bluebeard - symbolized by the opening of seven mysterious doors - ends in darkness and loneliness.

results.title: Pluto
results.overview: Green alien Pluto feels like a misfit on his stop-motion planet.

results.title: Maman Bibi Coco
results.overview: Célia, a mother in her thirties, finds herself suffocated by the daily demands of full-time parenting with a young son she can’t bring herself to stop breastfeeding, a fading marriage with her clueless yet devoted husband Bastien, and the grief of her father's recent death. Her fragile routine is upended when she meets Jérémy, a fellow parent who ignites her passion for music and awakens long-dormant feelings. Written, directed by and starring real-life couple Célia Millat and Bastien Garcia, this charming and intimate feature debut captures a woman at a turning point, exploring the vertigo of motherhood, the return of desire, and the challenge of finding one’s balance.

results.title: What if I never went into space?
results.original_title: Et si je n'allais jamais dans l'espace ?
results.overview: For years, my anxiety and I have been travelling everywhere, even going as far as outer space.

results.title: Raggot
results.overview: A military robot turned house servant learns what it means to be free. The only cost? Blood.

results.title: Hot Sand
results.overview: Co-directed by Rockaway residents, Emma Hastil and Kaia Abraham, “Hot Sand” was shot over the summer of 2025 in Rockaway. It’s a dreamy little glimpse of a hot summer day in a small town, following the people who make the community so unique, yet familiar.

results.title: Invierno ST/CR
results.overview: Set in Santa Teresa, Costa Rica, “Invierno” emerges from seven years of conversations in the lineup between the film’s Swedish-born director and surfer, Jakob Daschek, with fellow wave rider, Lorenzo Wickstrom Vargas. In Costa Rica and neighboring Central American countries, “invierno,” translates to the rainy season or green season in English, lasting from May through November. The film depicts how the summer is full of tourists, and when “invierno,” begins, it’s the season for the locals.

results.title: Sinking Rockaways
results.overview: A short documentary by Columbia University Graduate School of Journalism documentary filmmaking postgraduate student Sahar Sedaghat, following local resident Quinn Robinson and the Dune Squad as they work to restore and protect New York’s Rockaway coastline.

results.title: Betrayed
results.overview: Betrayed is a short narrative film written to raise awareness about sex trafficking and how it often hides in plain sight, sometimes through people we trust most. The story follows a young girl whose life is quietly derailed, and the loved ones and friends left searching for answers.
